$comment: The contract manifest: the authoritative list of the eight explainer tools — for each, the JSON Schema that defines its input and its output — and the authoritative list of the scaffold files the engine owns. This is a data document, not a schema. Every surface that speaks the protocol — the TypeScript MCP server, the hosted FastAPI server, the plugin bundles — derives its tool list from here, so a tool cannot be added to one surface and forgotten on another. The tool order below is the contract order and is preserved by codegen into TOOL_NAMES; engine_owned_files is preserved into ENGINE_OWNED_FILES the same way. open_enums names the string enums a consumer must decode leniently, mapping each to the member an unrecognised value falls back to; codegen turns each entry into a tolerant decoder in both languages, which is what makes adding a member a minor contract change (ADR 0024 §Note, 2026-09-06: P1-S3 settled).
name: xplainer

tools.name: explainer_create
tools.title: Create explainer
tools.description: Create a new explainer video and scaffold only its wiring — audio, captions and the timings contract — leaving the picture for the agent to design. Safe to call twice: it never overwrites.

tools.name: explainer_put_source
tools.title: Upload source
tools.description: Write agent-authored Remotion source files into an existing video, overwriting any file of the same path. Refuses the engine-owned files that mount the audio and captions — index.ts, types.ts, Root.tsx, Captions.tsx, Video.tsx — so write scenes to Scenes.tsx and the files it imports.

tools.name: explainer_put_media
tools.title: Upload media
tools.description: Upload one image, audio or video asset into a video's media directory, for the composition to reference through staticFile().

tools.name: explainer_narrate
tools.title: Narrate
tools.description: Synthesise the voiceover and word-level captions, and measure the segment timings the composition reads its durations from. Queued; poll explainer_job.

tools.name: explainer_still
tools.title: Render still
tools.description: Render one frame to PNG for a layout check, far faster than a full render. Queued; poll explainer_job.

tools.name: explainer_render
tools.title: Render video
tools.description: Render the video to MP4 — picture, voiceover and burnt-in captions in one pass. Requires explainer_narrate to have run. Queued; poll explainer_job.

tools.name: explainer_job
tools.title: Check job
tools.description: Report the status, exit code and recent output of a job started by explainer_narrate, explainer_render or explainer_still.

tools.name: explainer_list
tools.title: List explainers
tools.description: List the caller's explainer videos and what each one has so far: narration, a finished MP4, its size and its length.
